verdict.rationale: Grok Build is documented as a coding agent that edits files and runs bash commands. It follows build and test commands from AGENTS.md, can loop on checking whether the test suite passes, and can run a formatter via hooks after edits. That implies it can handle test and lint chores, but none of the four tasks in the story is explicitly documented. missing for 10: explicit docs or hands-on evidence of writing tests, fixing lint errors, resolving merge conflicts, and updating dependencies.
